name: Purple Leaf
author: Gaurav Mantri

sections.description:
Purple Leaf helps you grow your online presence by turning your WordPress content into ready-to-share social media posts — automatically.

This plugin connects your WordPress site to your Purple Leaf account and monitors changes to your posts and pages, such as:

  • New content created
  • Existing content updated
  • Posts moved to trash or permanently deleted
  • URL (slug) changes

Each event triggers a webhook to Purple Leaf, where your content is analyzed and transformed into optimized social media posts across platforms like LinkedIn, Facebook, Twitter (X), Instagram, and Threads.

🎯 Perfect for:

  • Content creators & bloggers
  • Startups and SaaS websites
  • Marketing teams
  • Anyone looking to simplify social media publishing

License

This plugin is licensed under the GPLv2 or later.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to your /wp-content/plugins/ directory or install it via the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu.
  3. Go to Settings → Purple Leaf and paste your connection key (you can get it from your Purple Leaf dashboard).
  4. That’s it — your WordPress site is now connected and ready to sync changes in real time.
sections.faq:
How do I get a connection key?

You can generate a connection key from your Purple Leaf dashboard at https://app.purpleleaf.ai.
Full instructions: https://purpleleaf.ai/how-to/connect-a-wordpress-site-to-purple-leaf

Which content types are supported?

Currently, the plugin supports standard Posts and Pages.
Support for WooCommerce Products and other custom post types is coming soon.

What happens when I update or delete a post?

Purple Leaf automatically tracks:
– Title/content changes
– Slug (URL) changes
– Status changes (published, draft, trashed)
– Featured image updates

Is this plugin free to use?

Yes, the plugin itself is free. You’ll need a Purple Leaf subscription to use the full automation features.
